name: Dankuni

queries.query: Dankuni West Bengal official cadastral map parcel land records map
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of West Bengal Banglarbhumi land-record portal, the Hooghly district administration, and the state WBDLRS land-and-land-reforms portal. Hooghly's official Srirampore subdivision page lists Dankuni among its municipalities. No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.
